parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The starting position of the results to return. The default value is 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of rows per page for a paged query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls list-s3-ingestions --project testproject --offset 0 --size 100 --logstore test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET /s3ingestions --project testproject --region cn-hangzhou --offset 0 --size 100 --logstore test --header "Content-Type=application/json"
